cc:Work.dc:title: MONOLITH Loading Screen 01 Rising Columns (Slate)

cc:Agent.dc:title: Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1; Anthropic - Claude Opus 5.5

cc:Work.dc:description: Loading screen built on the official emblem, the 4 x 4 MONOLITH M with its twelve pieces. The M's four columns rise out of the ground line at its feet like monoliths being raised, one after another (a clip at the base hides each column until it emerges); the pieces then settle onto their tiles; a rank of eight tiles below the wordmark fills as the bar. In a browser the CSS runs once and holds; in Inkscape the finished screen shows.
